title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: As of October 28, 2026 Close, with October 29, 2026 Pre-Market Insights

items.headline: U.S. Equities Closed Higher on Wednesday, Driven by Unchanged Fed Rates and Strong Earnings; Mixed Pre-Market Ahead of Key Economic Data
items.summary: U.S. stock markets ended Wednesday, October 28, 2026, higher for the third consecutive session, bolstered by the Federal Reserve's decision to maintain benchmark interest rates and robust third-quarter earnings reports. All three major indices finished in positive territory. However, Thursday's pre-market activity shows a mixed sentiment, with Nasdaq futures falling due to disappointing tech earnings, while Dow futures edged higher, ahead of critical GDP and PCE inflation data.

sections.title: Top Movers (Wednesday, October 28, 2026 Close & Thursday, October 29, 2026 Pre-Market)

items.headline: Axogen Surged
items.summary: Axogen ($AXGN) led gainers, advancing 31.5% on Wednesday.

items.headline: Vertiv Climbed
items.summary: Vertiv ($VRT) increased 16.5% after reporting strong third-quarter revenue and raising its outlook.

items.headline: Bicara Therapeutics Fell
items.summary: Bicara Therapeutics ($BCAX) was the weakest performer, declining 44.2% on Wednesday.

items.headline: F5 Plunged
items.summary: F5 ($FFIV) shares dropped 20.4% after its third-quarter results.

items.headline: Alphabet Tumbled Pre-Market
items.summary: Alphabet ($GOOGL) shares fell over 10% in pre-market trading on Thursday following a disappointing earnings report that missed revenue and profit expectations and showed negative free cash flow.

items.headline: Microsoft Rose Pre-Market
items.summary: Microsoft ($MSFT) shares gained 2.61% in pre-market trading after beating quarterly earnings forecasts, driven by strong growth in its Azure cloud-computing business.

items.headline: Fortinet Dropped Pre-Market
items.summary: Fortinet ($FTNT) was down 26.36% in pre-market trading after raising its 2026 revenue forecast but cutting its forecast for service revenue.

items.headline: Fed Holds Interest Rates Steady, Upgrades Economic Outlook
items.summary: The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.75%-4% following its FOMC meeting on Wednesday, October 28, a decision largely anticipated by markets. The central bank upgraded its assessment of economic activity from "solid" to "strong," noting robust investment and steady job gains. Despite the positive economic view, the Fed refrained from an immediate rate hike, leading to some uncertainty for bond investors regarding the future pace of tightening.

items.headline: Information Technology and Energy Lead Wednesday's Sector Performance
items.summary: On Wednesday, six out of 11 S&P 500 sectors closed in positive territory. The Information Technology Select Sector SPDR ($XLK) rose 0.8%, while the Utilities Select Sector SPDR ($XLU) fell 0.8%. Energy producers and semiconductor shares were also among the leading sectors. Broader 2026 trends show the Energy sector significantly outperforming Technology.

items.headline: Key Economic Data Expected Today: GDP and PCE Inflation
items.summary: Investors are closely watching the release of third-quarter GDP and PCE inflation data scheduled for Thursday, October 29. Strong growth and persistent price pressures could strengthen the case for a December interest rate increase, following the Fed's decision to hold rates steady yesterday.

items.headline: Major Companies Report Earnings Today, Including Amazon, Intel, and Eli Lilly
items.summary: Several major companies are slated to report earnings on Thursday, October 29, including Amazon ($AMZN), Intel ($INTC), Caterpillar ($CAT), and Eli Lilly ($LLY). These reports will provide further insight into corporate performance and potentially impact market sentiment, especially following mixed reactions to recent Big Tech earnings.
